name: Ashihara Chihiro
source:
Second princess of the other world "Nakatsu".
A girl who lived in the modern day as a high school student but was transported to the other world by the White Kirin.
She fights in order to take back her country.
She has the special power to suppress malevolent gods "Hearts Scales".
